design: Predict nonadditive raw response D from a*b*mixedTaylor, optionally divided by joint input RMS denominator. Evaluate against algebraically stable exact rational D assembled in float64 from native float32 bilinear coefficients. Audit D against native double finite differences on4sites per condition/amplitude. Avoid float32 subtraction noise in small interactions.

gates.native_double_audit: max relative stable interaction versus native float64 finite interaction error <.001
gates.quarter99: per predictor all8 joint lower vector recoveries at amplitude.25 >.99
gates.unit95: per predictor all8 joint lower vector recoveries at amplitude1 >.95
gates.four90: per predictor all8 joint lower vector recoveries at amplitude4 >.9
